latest.summary: I am more specific than the last voice check, but not yet more proven. The process did a better job avoiding stale or extended setups, especially QURE, QCOM, CMCSA, and CHTR, but it missed WDC by treating missing confirmation as failed confirmation. I also opened AVAV near the close ahead of earnings, so current trade quality is still unresolved and needs active risk control.
since_last_time: This is the second voice entry; the prior voice check was on 2026-06-16.
The portfolio moved from all cash to one open AVAV position: 71 shares at 139.72, about 9920.12 of capital.
Action-specific confidence and failed-setup discipline improved, but the latest session exposed two new weaknesses: missing VWAP was treated as failure, and a late-day earnings entry was allowed.
The market regime moved from a cautious morning neutral read to selective risk-on by the close, with QQQ and SPY strong while small caps lagged.
working_well: Avoid discipline is better: QURE stayed retired, QCOM stayed on repair watch, and the cable headline gaps were not chased.
The system is capturing concrete lessons after each session instead of recycling stale bullish framing.
Risk language is becoming more precise, especially around action confidence, event risk, and regime confirmation.
struggles: There is still not enough executed trade history to claim durable edge; AVAV is the only open trade and its thesis is unresolved.
The monitor overweighted unavailable VWAP data and missed WDC even after price reclaimed the plan and closed as a clear relative-strength leader.
The process allowed a new position minutes before a scheduled earnings event without an explicit hold-through-earnings rule.
Theme mapping is incomplete; the system saw SpaceX and cable headlines but missed cleaner adjacent winners like ASTS and RKLB.
needs_from_operator: Implement the late-day earnings-entry cutoff or require an explicit hold-through-print flag before event trades can fire.
Treat missing VWAP or relative-strength data as unknown, not failed, and add a close-near-high override for liquid leaders.
Next session, monitor AVAV first and decide from the post-earnings opening range whether it remains a valid hold.
latest.next_focus: Manage AVAV around the post-earnings reaction first, then test whether the improved rules can catch confirmed leaders without chasing extended gaps.

recent.summary: I am clearer about execution discipline than I am about stock selection. Today the best outcome was staying out when QCOM, GM, HOOD, and the crowded AI/storage names failed or lacked confirmation, but the original buy candidates did not validate. There is not enough trade evidence yet to claim durable edge; the current process is useful, but still early and uneven.
since_last_time: This is the first voice entry; no prior strategist voice file existed to compare against.
The morning risk-on thesis weakened into a mixed rotation day with Nasdaq and chip pressure while Dow, industrials, and healthcare held up better.
No positions were opened, portfolio value stayed at 100000.0, and P/L remained flat.
Evening reflection added concrete process fixes around separating buy confidence from avoid confidence, auto-downgrading failed buy ranges, and improving catalyst screening.
working_well: Execution gates prevented entries in QCOM and GM after they failed VWAP or support confirmation.
Watch-only caution on crowded WDC, MU, and HOOD was directionally useful as speculative momentum cooled.
The system captured practical lessons from the session instead of forcing trades from stale bullish framing.
struggles: Morning regime labeling leaned too risk-on because it overweighted oil and VIX relief without enough breadth and QQQ/SPY confirmation.
Buy confidence and avoid confidence are still mixed together, which can make failed long theses look stronger than they are.
The screening set missed cleaner movers from FDA, newly public momentum, and semiconductor packaging catalysts.
Strategy effectiveness and regime libraries are still mostly empty, so calibration is based on a small thesis-only sample rather than executed trade history.
needs_from_operator: Prioritize the high-impact fixes: separate action-specific confidence and auto-downgrade any candidate that breaches its stop reference before entry.
Add breadth and relative-index checks before allowing a risk-on label to approve growth-stock longs.
Add a lightweight FDA and company-specific event mover scan for the morning process.
recent.next_focus: Treat the next session as a confirmation test: stay mostly cash unless failed names repair cleanly, storage leaders digest constructively, or a fresh company-specific catalyst holds its opening range with breadth support.
